channel.title: Dining With The Chef Mini
channel.desc: Dining with the Chef Mini introduces traditional techniques and resourceful recipes in just 5 minutes! Chefs Saito and Rika present their unique approaches to cooking delicious Japanese food. In this episode, chef Rika will show you a plating technique for noodles using soba, buckwheat noodles topped with meat. Join us and learn how to make an original meaty buckwheat noodle dish at home.
